title: Grayton Dreams
meta_description: Grayton Dreams is a spacious group retreat that sleeps 32, with a private pool, game room, covered balcony, and two 6-seater golf carts.
description_expanded:
There's a certain kind of trip that only works when everyone can actually fit---without compromise. This is that place.

Spanning four thoughtfully designed levels, this home was built for large groups who want to stay together and spread out. Mornings unfold slowly here---coffee in the kitchen, sunlight drifting through the main living spaces, conversations starting in one room and carrying into the next. With multiple gathering areas, no one competes for space, and the energy of the group can shift naturally throughout the day.

The layout makes it easy to balance connection and privacy. King suites are tucked across the upper floors, offering quiet retreats with private or semi-private baths, while the bunk rooms bring a more playful, flexible energy---perfect for kids, late-night conversations, or groups of friends who don't mind sharing stories long after the lights go out.

Downstairs, the game room becomes its own world. Pool games stretch into the evening, something's always on the TV, and there's just enough separation from the main living space to let the night take on a life of its own.

Outside, the rhythm changes again. A private pool invites long, unstructured afternoons, while the covered balcony sets the scene for dinners that linger---grilling, passing plates, and eating together in the open air as the day winds down.

Two 6-seater golf carts make getting around effortless, whether you're heading out to explore or just want to keep the group moving without breaking the flow.

This is a home designed for togetherness without crowding---for shared meals, parallel mornings, late nights, and everything in between. The kind of place where 32 people don't feel like too many---they feel like exactly the point.

AvantStay provides an upscale experience with services that elevate your stay and save time so you can enjoy every moment. Guests have access to a 24/7 support team and a tech-enabled concierge to book services, such as fridge stocking, mid-stay cleanings, and private chefs. For anything you need (or never knew you needed), we're at your service!

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- The pool is not heated.

Parking Details:
- Driveway parking is available for 5 cars max.
- Paid parking is available at Grayton Storage Facility.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
